note: Persona specifications for evaluation/run-simulations.mjs. SIMULATED PERSONAS for portfolio evaluation — AI plays these roles; they are not real people. 'Prior' sets what the persona has already seen before playing the scenario (none = just the story; job-aid = has read the Feedback in 5 minutes job aid).

personas.name: Nile — newly promoted, conflict-averse
personas.profile: Promoted 4 months ago from senior nurse; 13 direct reports; no management training; finds hard conversations frightening; wants to be liked by former peers.

personas.name: Marta — experienced clinic manager, task-focused
personas.profile: 11 years managing; runs quick daily round-ups and calls them feedback; skeptical of 'soft skills' talk; measured on throughput.

personas.name: Devon — cautious new manager, rule-following
personas.profile: Promoted 6 months ago; reads every policy; worried about saying the wrong thing; tends to defer to policy and escalate upward.

personas.name: Bao — pragmatic ops-minded manager
personas.profile: Operations background; values speed and measurable outcomes; sees one-on-ones as admin unless shown the payoff; open-minded but impatient.
